plans.idea: Centered vertical stack that keeps the original's reading order (logo, bottle, headline and subcopy, button) but makes the logo a proper centered masthead and enlarges the bottle and headline so the dead space between bands goes away.

Two-column split: the bottle fills the left half at full height, and the right column holds a left-aligned stack of logo, headline and subcopy, and button on one shared edge, so the square reads left to right.

Editorial corner layout: logo and a large headline block anchor the top left, the bottle sits big in the bottom-right quadrant as the counterweight, and the button closes the left column, making a diagonal reading path from headline to product to action.
